steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Master? It's so dark here... Why can't I see anything...?

steps.name: Wuxian
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm right here.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Then what are we here for? Are you going to teach me a new move?!

steps.name: Wuxian
steps.text: Xiaohei, to perceive the nature spirit, you mustn't rely on your five senses alone.

steps.name: Wuxian
steps.text: I've temporarily sealed your vision to improve your sensitivity to the presence of metal around you.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Ugh, I can't see anything. This is hard...

steps.name: Wuxian
steps.text: I have a metal ball stored in my pocket. How much you can perceive?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mmgh... it's really fuzzy, but I think so!

steps.name: Wuxian
steps.text: Good. I'll carry it as I walk around you. You must determine my position by sensing it. Relax. I won't move too far from you.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: What if I can't do it, master?

steps.name: Wuxian
steps.text: No need to fret, we'll take it slow. Now, come and catch me.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: ...Okay, um... on the left, I think?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: There's nothing here. It feels like you're behind me.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Master?! No, not there.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (I need to calm down, mmgh... there!)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Darn, I messed up again.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Where are you, Master?! This is too hard. I don't think I can do it.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Master, say something...

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Master, where are you...?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Master?!

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mroaaaw—!

steps.name: Xiaobai
steps.text: (Yawns) What's wrong, Xiaohei? Were you having a bad dream?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Meow.

steps.name: Xiaobai
steps.text: (Rubs Xiaohei's head) I'm right here, it's okay.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mew!

steps.name: Xiaobai
steps.text: Go back to sleep.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Licks Xiaobai's hand) Mreww.

steps.name: Xiaobai
steps.text: I'm here... it's okay... *snore*...

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Did she fall asleep?)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Tiptoes off the bed)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (I can't get any sleep now. Might as well take a walk outside.)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I keep dreaming about Master the last few days.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I don't even know when we'll be able to go back. It's been so long, he has to be looking for me.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I wonder if Ah Gen and Xiaobai miss Mom, Dad, and Grandpa too?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mm. We've gotta find a way back as soon as we can.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: And I guess I should go back and sleep... Uh, where am I, though?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Am I... lost?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: *huff*... *pant*... I'm beat.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: And wasn't I just here?!

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: This ship's way too big. I'm never gonna find my way back.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: And there's no one to ask for directions this late either.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Are people fighting?! Shoot, what if a bad guy got in?!

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I've gotta give 'em a proper greeting, then.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I think the sounds were coming from this room.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Huh? Isn't this where the operators usually train? Is that... Mr. Fu?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: No, he doesn't wear clothes like that.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: It's not sunup yet, I've still got time for four more sets of shadowboxing.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Hup, hup. Jab-jab, cross.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Rragh!!! Again!

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Wow, look at those fists... He beat a sandbag out of shape with just a few punches.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I dunno who's stronger, me or him.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: (Twitches ears) Hrm...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: (Stops punching) Who's there?!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: A Feline kid?! Are you a patient here?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: No, I'm an operator, like you.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: They made you an operator that young? I find that hard to believe... What exactly can you do?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Don't underestimate me, I'm real strong. If you don't believe me, we can have a showdown.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Let's not. I'm not confident I can stop my fists before you get hurt.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: No need to hold back, gimme all you've got!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I... No. What sort of self-respecting adult bullies a child?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Assumes stance) How will you know if you don't try?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: (He has a measured posture, with very stable footing. There does seem to be something to him... Fine, can't hurt to help him train.)

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Well then, my young friend, stay sharp.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Huff—

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: You're as quick as lightning, for someone your age. I'm confident in my jabs, but I don't see myself landing any clean hits on you.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Wipes off sweat)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Your fists are incredible. I could barely dodge by a hair.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Hahahah. It seems I've only scratched the surface of what this ship's operators can really do. That reminds me, my friend—what are you doing here at this hour?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I couldn't get to sleep, so I went out for a walk, and... got lost. Now I don't know the way back to the dorm.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: You must be new here then. I can sympathize—this place sprawls, and they don't make things simple. Learning to navigate it can be a challenge.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: But aren't children your age usually getting sleepy around now?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I... I've got some stuff on my mind.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: (Do children today really have so much weighing on them, so young?)

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Never mind, let's call it here. Let me show you the way back.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I've lost a button from my jacket.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: A button? You could just go and sew a new one on.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: They don't make this sort anymore. It won't be easy to come by.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Try a different one, then?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Unfortunately, they're special to me. I've always treasured them, since my father had a particular love for them on his own coats... It'd be a shame to lose it.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: For now, let me walk you back. I'll retrace my steps tomorrow and see if I can find it.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Is it really important to you?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Yes. I think of my father whenever I see them.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Then... are they made of metal?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: They are.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I'll help you look! I've got the ability to sense metal. A metal button like those ones, right? I can pinpoint it if it's not too far.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: So you wield such Originium Arts too... But no, go back and get some rest. If I can't find it tomorrow, I'll come straight to you. How's that?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: It's fine, I'm all pumped up right now. I wouldn't be able to sleep anyway.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Then by all means, my friend. But before I forget, my name is Anthony Simon, and it's a pleasure to meet you. You can also use my codename 'Mountain,' if you so prefer. What's your name?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I'm Xiaohei!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Would you like me to carry you?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: N—No, it's fine, I'm not a kid!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Hahahah, I understand. Stick close to me, then. Let's try not lose our way again.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I came here to do some reading this morning, and may well have lost the button somewhere by the bookshelves. Can you sense anything?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Umm... I think there's something really small and round.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Raises hand up and forms a fist)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: It's not a button though, it's a coin. Do you want it?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I see, a game token... Can you sense any similar metals?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: ...There's nothing else. Sorry.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: That's fine, no doubt it lies elsewhere. Come to think of it though, have you had the chance to try the games here? Logistics has acquired quite a few game disks and tapes.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I don't really play that stuff. Do you?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Er, I can't say I do, these days. If I'm here, it's most likely only to borrow some books.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: ...I don't really read books either. I only know a few of the shapes in them.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Would you like to, then?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I would! But...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: As I recall, there also have picture books here, meant for schooling children... Right, there they are. Here.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: So this one has all pictures? Thank you...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: All it takes is to be an earnest reader. Be it words or pictures, you'll find yourself reaping the rewards.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Okay, let's be on our way. Hold onto that book. I think we'll visit Miss Lena's garden next—I assisted her with moving some goods around noontime.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: ...Are they gone? I literally play here at night so I *don't* see other people. Who'd have thought someone'd come anyway?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I mean, they are gone by now, right? Like, *gone* gone?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Alright, continue from save, I guess. Let's see... what do I equip? Bow's good for clearing trash in this stage, but melee's better for the boss fight. Choices, choices...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Puts down controller)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Orrr... maybe I should've tried to say hello when they came in.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: How very lucky of us. We came just in time to find the queens of the night in bloom.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: These flowers are so pretty! They smell so gentle, too. It's nice.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Draws a deep breath)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mmm... okay, we'll have to keep looking for your button, it's not here. Maybe the next place.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: There's no need to rush, Xiaohei. You enjoy it here, don't you? We can look around a while longer.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Can we?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Miss Lena takes excellent care of this garden, and most of the flowers here are for her own perfumes. If you ever have trouble sleeping again, have her mix some soothing fragrances for your room.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Miss... Lena? Then who's that man over there?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: (Shoots a glance at Xiaohei)

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Miss Lena bade an operator to help pick the flowers, I presume... After all, queens of the night don't bloom at any other time.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Oh, I get it, no wonder he's got such a long sword. I bet it cuts stuff real neatly.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: *sniff* *sniff*

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (This queen of the night thing smells really good. I wonder if you can eat it. It couldn't hurt to try a little, right?)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Moves to bite) Ahh—

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Weird little brat. You like how it smells, so you immediately go to give it a bite?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: What's so weird about it? Can't you eat these?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Pardon us, sir. Children often think in peculiar ways. We mean no offense.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Suit yourselves. Just don't bother me.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: It's not like we'd get in the way of your work from all the way over here.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Wrong. I'm not working.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: I'm awaiting the unparalleled beauty revealed by the spectacle of life at the moment it verges on disappearance. It passes in the blink of an eye, so I must devote all my focus to it.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I... didn't get any of that.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I'd imagine he means the queen of the night only blooms for a few hours. Admire it while you can, for it will wilt before you know it.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: It only blooms for that long? I'm not eating it, then. Just watching is enough.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: (Shaking head) Tch. Children...

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I bet... that man's got amazing sword skills, right?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Hahahah, you want to spar with him too? Don't do it here, at least. Miss Lena wouldn't be happy to see people getting into fights in her garden.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Okay! Then let's go to the next place and find your button!

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: That garden was so pretty though, I wanna bring Xiaobai and Ah Gen there next time. Um, Xiaobai and Ah Gen are my friends.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Well, nothing is stopping you. Miss Lena's garden is open to all operators. Feel free to visit it at any time.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hello, Mountain, this is awfully early. I almost thought you were Ethan. And who's your friend here?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I'm Xiaohei. I'm helping Mountain look for his button.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I may have lost it here, you see. You wouldn't happen to have to seen it, would you Matterhorn?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: If I find any lost items when I'm cleaning, I put them in that box over there. You're welcome to take a look.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Alright then. Thank you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Um... I tried sensing just a moment ago. There's no metal in there at all.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Really? How troublesome—this was the last place I visited yesterday. After that, I spent the whole time in the training room until you arrived.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: How about we start again from the beginning? I'm sure we'll find it.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I'll spare you the hassle and see you back to the dorms. It's late. Children won't grow tall without enough sleep.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Then what about the button? Are you gonna give up?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Mm. Perhaps someone else picked it up. Tomorrow, I'll post a lost item notice and see where that gets me.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I'm sorry I wasn't any help...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: But you wanted to, and that's more than enough for me. Thank you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What's the matter? You couldn't find it?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Indeed. The boy's more upset about it than I am, and I'm the one who lost it.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Here, Xiaohei, have some candy from my homeland. Don't let it get to you.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Thank you, Matterhorn...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: (Pats Xiaohei's head) Come on then, let's be off.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Would you like to learn how to read? I don't have much in the way of upcoming missions, so I can certainly find the time to teach you.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Sure...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Have you tried the candy he gave you? How does it taste?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Not yet...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: You don't have to feel so bad, Xiaohei. It's just a tiny little button. It's alright.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: But you said it was really important...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Meow, we meet again, you giant boulder. And you've brought a darling Feline along to boot?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Haze. What are you doing out this late?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Shh. Someone had a thirst for a stroll tonight, so I had to come out with.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: But there's nobody with you...?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It's my hat. A moment of peace is ever so elusive with this thing around. Don't you agitate it, meow.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (This lady... speaks weird.)

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Stay, stay, I'm just giving these two operators a meow-do-you-do. I'll be right on my way. You settle down now.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Yes, I know, it was our titan here who bumped into me on the way to the training room this afternoon. But he apologized, you know. No need to be so mewdy.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Whisper) Who's she talking to?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: (Whisper) Her hat.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Dear me. Boulder, little Feline, I need to be on my way. Even more deranged things will spill out of me if I stay any longer.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Suddenly furrows brows)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Wait, what's that... That's it, she has it on her!)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Miss, could you hold on for just for a moment?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: What is it, little Feline? Are you looking to prize yet more nonsense out of your friendly witch?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Can I, um, ask what's in your pocket?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Just some loose odds and ends.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Reaches out, and then suddenly forms a fist)

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh! Is this some Originium Arts? Why are the things in my pocket flying out at you?!

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Opens hand) Mountain, is this your button?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Hrm. Yes. Haze, why would you have my button on you?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, meow... I've been caught.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I have far more valuable items on me. Why insist on stealing a single button?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Sticks out tongue) It had far too pretty a design for its own good—my heart leapt on seeing it, and it seemed not to cost so dearly. I would've given it back to you after I had my bit of fun with it.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: It may not be valuable, but it's really important to Mountain! He was so worried when he lost it!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: You have to understand, my father used to love this kind of button. Add the fact that they don't sell them anymore, and you can see why it's so significant to me.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: My apologies. I didn't know it was so precious to you... I had no intent to hurt you, boulder that you are.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: If you ever need any assistance in future, come seek me, why don't you? Let me make up for this mishap.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: No need for that. Now that we've found it, all's well that ends well.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Hugs Xiaohei) Thank you, little Feline.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mmngh?! What's your deal?!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: If it weren't for mew, I would've broken my very own set of rules, and neither my hat nor I would be delighted about that.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Struggling) I get it. Now let me go.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Releases Xiaohei)

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Hah, hah, hah! So long then, little Feline. With your cuteness, we'd be remiss not to see each other plenty more in future. Meow revoir.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: She's such a weirdo. I caught her stealing stuff, and she thanked me for it.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I'd have to assume she's drawn lines she doesn't want to cross, as a thief.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Aren't you mad at her?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I'm more grateful to you than mad at her, Xiaohei. I'd never have found it so easily without your help.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: No problem. You're my friend.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: And I'm honored to be so.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Yawn—)

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Will you be alright for tomorrow, after staying up this late?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: It's okay, there's nothing important happening.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Then could you tell me why you're having trouble sleeping?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I—I miss my Master.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Xiaohei, the reason I use the same buttons my father did is because doing what he used to lets me feel closer to him.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Though he's no longer here, that feeling remains unchanged.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Perhaps you'd like to try something like that too. Do something your Master would do. It might make you feel better.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Something Master would do...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Mountain! Xiaohei! Excuse me, make way, please! Emergency!

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: That's the Medical Department right up ahead. I assume something happened to a patient and they need emergency treatment.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Do they always work this late?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: There's no day or night in Medical. So long as they're needed, they have to stay on call.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I can see the lights in there... It's as bright as daytime.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: It seems you're aching for a look. Would you like to visit?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Yeah, I know one of the sick people in there, but I don't know how she's been doing lately. I wanna see her.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Then no time like the present.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Rate of originium crystal expansion is accelerated in patient's lungs, function severely impaired. Not good. Heartbeat faint. Prepare the emergency facilities!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Did the drugs make it yet?

steps.name: Medic Operator A
steps.text: Right here, coming now!

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Lend a hand. I'll run through emergency care.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Looks like they're really busy. I'll come back tomorrow.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Comatose Patient
steps.text: Hphhh—hphhh—

steps.name: Medic Operator A
steps.text: Operator Sussurro, patient is having trouble with voluntary breathing. We have to remove their respirator and intubate.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Anesthetist on standby, please! Emergency intubation! Scalpel!

steps.name: Medic Operator B
steps.text: All ready. I'll hold him steady.

steps.name: Comatose Patient
steps.text: (Breathing resumes)

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: (Wipes forehead) Good. Let's move him into the theater for the next stage of treatment.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: What's so fascinating, Xiaohei?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: That lady... she's amazing.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Agreed. These Medic Operators have always been the pride of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: When they give me missions in future, will I be helping people with the stone disease like they are?

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Stone disease? Do you mean Oripathy? We don't do quite what the medics do—usually, our missions are more aimed at improving conditions for sufferers.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: But in some extreme cases, we need to make a stand in violent conflicts centered around the Infected.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: That sounds like what Master does. He helps out spirits without a home, and hunts down the ones who do bad things.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Spirits...? That's a fine thing, though, wouldn't you say? You'll be doing exactly what your Master does. How do you feel about that?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: ...Really happy, and really proud, that I can do what he did.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: So do you feel a little better now?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Yep!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Then you'd better go get some sleep for real. Go on back.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: I've finished all these books. I wonder if I can find Mountain again, and have him recommend more.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Oh, isn't that him right there? Perfect, I'll go say hi.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: A little black cat? Miss.Christine? Wait, no, that's not her.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Who's Christine? Oh, I forgot he's never seen me transform before.)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Meow...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: You have Xiaohei's scent about you. Do you happen to know him?

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (I'll just let him think so for now...)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mraaow—

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Hm? Do you want to read this too? Hahah, come on over. Let's read together.

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: Mreww...

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (I can't read any of these words...)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (Yawns)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: (So sleepy...)

steps.name: Xiaohei
steps.text: *snore*...

steps.name: Mountain
steps.text: Climbing on my shoulder just to fall asleep? You're a curious one. Oh, well, I'll be sure to turn the pages quietly.
